description: Stage 3 admission counts a flow as in flight from local state. A local plan branch with a checkpoint at execute or review still blocks new flows after its pull request has merged and its branch was deleted on origin, because admission never asks the remote and a local ref or worktree alone is enough to refuse. An overlap refusal also does not say where the blocker was found, so a stale match cannot be told from a live one.
goal: 1) Before every Stage 3 admission check, run 'git fetch --prune origin' in the target repository; if the fetch fails, refuse admission with the reason (fail closed). 2) A flow is in flight only when its I-* execution branch still exists on origin AND either its pull request is open or a live runner process holds its worktree (a process whose command line names that worktree). A local branch or worktree alone never blocks, and a branch whose pull request is merged or closed never blocks. 3) Every overlap refusal logs how each blocker was found: the ref name, whether it was found locally or on the remote, and the pull request number and state where one exists. 4) Keep the existing touch-set comparison unchanged across flow/admission.py, flow/admission_decision.py, flow/in_flight.py, flow/in_flight_liveness.py, flow/worktree_checkpoints.py, flow/lazy_exports.py, and touch_set_overlap.py, keeping tests/flow/test_admission.py, tests/flow/test_admission_remote_in_flight.py, tests/flow/test_in_flight.py, tests/flow/test_admission_order.py, and tests/flow/stages/test_execute_touch_set.py green. 5) Module line budgets (holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) are frozen: never change that file; if a change would push a module past its limit, split the module. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: A flow whose pull request has merged can keep local branches and a checkpoint for minutes after the merge; counting it as in flight refuses unrelated flows on a merged flow's files and forces manual relaunches. Judging in-flight state from origin, after a prune, and logging how each blocker was found makes a stale match visible at once.
acceptance_criteria: A hermetic test: a flow whose pull request has merged, whose local I-* branch and worktree still exist and whose remote branch is gone after the prune does not block admission.
A hermetic test: a local branch and worktree with no open pull request, no remote I-* branch and no live runner process do not block admission.

A hermetic test: an open pull request whose I-* branch exists on origin blocks admission on its changed files, and the refusal names the pull request number and state and that the ref was found on the remote.
A hermetic test: a failing 'git fetch --prune origin' refuses admission with its reason.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest', and 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.

Remote in-flight discovery and liveness checks across flow/admission.py, flow/admission_decision.py, flow/in_flight.py, flow/in_flight_liveness.py, flow/worktree_checkpoints.py, flow/lazy_exports.py, and touch_set_overlap.py keep tests/flow/test_admission.py, tests/flow/test_admission_remote_in_flight.py, tests/flow/test_in_flight.py, tests/flow/test_admission_order.py, and tests/flow/stages/test_execute_touch_set.py green.
